decisions.briefing: Markets were essentially flat today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal, and available cash ($89.29) is far below the $500 threshold needed to fund a new position anyway. Held all 7 existing positions unchanged and made no new buys, consistent with the lesson to avoid forcing trades on neutral, low-conviction days.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted modestly lower today in quiet, low-volatility trading, with NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%. There was no dominant catalyst driving the move — it reflects a market pausing to digest recent gains rather than reacting to a specific shock. Sector leadership was mixed, consistent with a wait-and-see tone among investors.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡，納斯達克指數下跌0.1%，標普500指數下跌0.2%，成交量低迷。市場並無明顯的單一催化劑帶動走勢，反而更像是在消化近期升幅後的暫時喘息。各板塊表現參差，反映投資者普遍抱持觀望態度。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on hand rather than fully invested, so you have the flexibility to act quickly when a genuine opportunity appears. Today's cash balance is too small to fund a new position and the market gave no strong signal, so the disciplined move is to hold that cash rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者保留現金而非全數投入市場，以便在真正的機會出現時能迅速把握。今日現金水平太低，不足以建立新倉位，加上市場亦未發出明確信號，因此紀律性的做法是繼續持有現金，而非勉強交易。
